meta.title: Add -M/--find-renames option and blame.renames config to control rename detection
meta.body_summary: Add --find-renames option and blame.renames config to skip rename detection in git blame for performance, with documentation and tests.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot attempted to add rename control to git blame but used conflicting -M option and incorrect linkage; dscho provided detailed feedback; PR later superseded by #894.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 370 changed lines across 8 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume. It fits a targeted performance feature addition, but was closed without merge due to fundamental design issues and later superseded by another PR.

review_details.concern_detail: dscho noted that existing -M in git blame means something else (detect moved or copied lines within a file), not whole-file rename detection, so reusing it is wrong. Also, the static variable in builtin/blame.c cannot be accessed from blame.c, and the similarity threshold was misused as boolean.
review_details.performance_claim: Disabling rename detection improves git blame performance by avoiding expensive blob comparisons.
review_details.rejection_signals: Superseded by #894; maintainer indicated fundamental design issues with option name and implementation, and later closed in favor of alternative PR.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Git internals and command-line option consistency require deep understanding of existing codebase and conventions; Copilot's initial approach conflicted with existing option semantics and static linking, and even after attempted fixes, the design was not accepted.

detection_detail.code_reading: dscho reviewed diff hunks in detail, pointing out each issue with code and documentation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes a test script, but performance claims are not backed by benchmarks; test is more about functionality.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed after being superseded by #894; no fix-in-PR cycle led to acceptance.

core_change_summary.description: Add -M/--find-renames option and blame.renames config to control rename detection in git blame, modifying builtin/blame.c to parse new options and pass a rename score to blame.c, updating documentation, and adding a test script.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation updates and blame.h change for new struct field; test script added then reduced per review.
change_trajectory: Initial commit added option parsing and config, documentation, and test.
Review feedback pointed out incorrect use of -M and static variable scope.
Subsequent commits attempted to fix static issue by adding blame_scoreboard field, adjust option parsing, and simplify tests, but fundamental -M conflict remained.

review_signals.summary: Noted that existing -M in git blame means something else and cannot be reused; suggested abandoning the idea of using -M.
review_signals.action_taken: Agent did not rename the option; PR ultimately superseded.

review_signals.summary: Inline comment on blame-options.adoc: cannot reuse -M; must introduce a new --find-renames option.
blame.c: static variable in builtin/blame.c cannot be accessed from blame.c; must add attribute to blame_scoreboard struct.
review_signals.action_taken: Later commit added rename_scoreboard field in blame.h.

review_signals.summary: blame.c: rename_detection_mode used as boolean; must study diff*.c to use --find-renames value correctly.
Test script: do not use git init, use test_write_lines, specify explicit file, add test_tick, and reduce test cases.
review_signals.action_taken: Agent simplified tests and addressed some syntax issues.

review_signals.summary: Commented that this PR is superseded by #894.
review_signals.action_taken: PR left open then eventually closed.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with initial implementation of rename detection control.
Maintainer dscho provided 9 inline review comments and a formal review pointing out design flaws.
Copilot responded with multiple commits addressing some feedback but did not change the option name.
PR remained open for a long period and was eventually closed after being superseded by #894.
